correctness.rationale: The one-positive section density factors exactly by conditioning on the unique positive exponential term; AM-GM gives the sec(theta) angular lower bound. The global low-sublevel threshold follows from the recent classification of no-zero critical normals together with explicit lower-dimensional boundary ratios and two-value gamma-convolution ratios. Direct differentiation of the exact chamber formula along every unit spherical tangent direction gives Hess(log V)=((2n-1)/n)g.

originality.rationale: The recent sharp-minimum paper establishes the facet-parallel minimizers and critical-point classification but does not state a Hessian, stability theorem, or quantitative near-minimizer estimate. The located earlier stability paper treats Webb's sharp maximum, while the older partial minimum work does not state the sec(theta) deficit, the finite global sublevel gap, or the Hessian. Targeted literature searches did not locate these refinements.

value.rationale: The result turns the newly solved qualitative minimum problem into a quantitative small-deficit theory: it supplies an exact factorization, a computable global threshold forcing near-minimizers into a controlled sign chamber, an explicit distance-to-extremizer bound, and the complete isotropic quadratic form at the minimizers.
